description: This C# source file defines extension methods for the IServiceCollection to configure and manage IOptionFormatter and related services within the Orleans framework, facilitating dependency injection and configuration of option formatters.

classes.name: OptionConfigureExtensionMethods
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure option formatters and resolvers in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Configures an IOptionFormatter for TOptions, adding it as a singleton service if not already registered.

methods.name: ConfigureFormatter<TOptions>
methods.description: Configures an IOptionFormatter for TOptions with a default formatter, chaining with other services.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatter
methods.description: Attempts to configure an IOptionFormatter for TOptions only if not already configured.

methods.name: TryConfigureFormatterResolver
methods.description: Attempts to configure an IOptionFormatterResolver for TOptions if none is configured.

methods.name: ConfigureNamedOptionForLogging
methods.description: Configures a named option formatter for logging purposes.
